selectionRule: Rank 27 fixed configurations on 2019/20 and 2020/21 log loss. Select among legacy, previous v2, the complete grid and fixed ablations on pooled 2021/22 and 2022/23 log loss. These four seasons are development/validation data. Freeze the winner before reading later test metrics. Ties within 1e-12 favour the first candidate: legacy, v2, grid in declared order, ablations.
ablationRule: Fixed chain: opponent strengths alone, add home advantage, add 90-day decay, add DC penalty 100, add six-match shrinkage. Also remove each component separately from v2.
historyRule: Latest 200 eligible same-league results within 365 days. At least 50 competition results for warm-up. Refit before each date using only eligible past outcomes. No same-day results; no test-outcome hyperparameter tuning.
knownResults: Premier League 2023/24 was previously inspected; Premier League 2022/23 was previous development data. La Liga 2023/24 and both 2024/25 leagues are the fresh subset.
protocolRevision: Version 1 compared only the tuning winner, legacy and v2 on selection seasons. Version 2 included the complete already-declared grid and ablations after inspecting earlier-season validation diagnostics, before reading later-season metrics. A first test file had been computed automatically but not inspected. This is validation-stage protocol development, not preregistration. After final metrics were read the temporary checkout was lost; this restored implementation reruns the same grid and split, without changing candidates or settings.
releaseRule: Keep legacy unless the one frozen earlier-selected candidate beats it on pooled later log loss. This release fallback is not another tuning round or a fresh accuracy estimate. Never select another configuration using test ablations.
metrics: Natural-log loss primary, summed multiclass Brier secondary. Fixed 0.10 draw calibration bins. No test-set calibration fitting.
